description: 3 positives (1 de) + 2 near-misses + 1 counterexample. Positives all ask for a Playwright spec to be written or fixed — a browser flow, a visual baseline, a page object. The near-misses are the two neighbours: designing the suite's architecture (playwright-architect) and planning which E2E cases to cover before any spec exists. The counterexample guards the word 'test' for a unit test with no browser.

queries.q: write a playwright spec that logs in and checks the dashboard loads
add a visual regression test with toHaveScreenshot for the pricing card
schreib einen Playwright-Test fuer den Checkout mit einem Page Object
decide how our E2E suite should be sharded, which fixtures are global and how auth state is reused across workers
plan which end-to-end scenarios we need before anyone writes a spec
write a unit test for the date formatting helper
